original_description: VOSU generates images, videos and 3D models with leading AI models using the user's existing VOSU account and credits. Users describe what they want and pick a model, animate a photo they upload into a short video, turn an image into a 3D model, and browse, replay or download everything they have generated. Every prompt passes a content-safety check before anything is charged, and the credit balance can be checked before any spend.
summary_ja: 画像・動画・3Dモデルを生成し、写真から動画や3Dモデルも作成する。
limitations: VOSUアカウントとクレジットを使用すると説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
